name: Ladd McConkey

background.fact: Born November 11, 2001 (age 25); grew up in Chatsworth, Georgia, and attended North Murray High School, where he played quarterback, running back, defensive back and punter and returned kicks.
In his senior year he led North Murray to a 9-1 record and its first region championship, with 36 total touchdowns and 3,051 total yards; North Murray retired his number 15 in 2023.
He was a three-star recruit whose only Power Five offer was Georgia; he won two national championships there, graduated in 2023 with a finance degree, and won the 2023 Wuerffel Trophy.
In the January 2023 national title game he caught 5 passes for 88 yards and 2 touchdowns in a 65-7 win.
Chargers drafted him in round 2, pick 34 of the 2024 draft; he is a third-year receiver listed at 6 ft 0 in, 185 lb, jersey 15, with a 4.39 forty at the combine.
Career regular season: 38 games, 165 catches on 242 targets, 2,224 yards, 14 touchdowns. 2024: 82 catches, 1,149 yards, 7 touchdowns; 2025: 66 catches, 789 yards, 6 touchdowns.
Madden week 8 rating is 84 overall with Slot-O-Matic and Short In Elite abilities.

family.fact: His father Benji McConkey was a star high school quarterback at Dalton High; his brother Hinton McConkey played quarterback at West Georgia in 2018. He is a middle child and grew up a Tennessee Volunteers fan.
He married his high school sweetheart Sydney Horne on April 12, 2025.
He writes 1-20-16 on his towel before games to honor his late grandfather Vic McConkey.

scouts_read: McConkey's status is the whole story: he is questionable with back spasms after sitting out Week 9 and missing practice Thursday and Friday, and the call may not come until about 90 minutes before kickoff. The Chargers are 0-8, score the fewest touchdowns in the league, and are a 4.5 point underdog with an implied total of 17. Even a healthy McConkey has been quiet this season, with 286 yards in 6 games. If he is limited or out, Harris and Johnston become the main targets for Herbert. I would treat him as a risky flex play and keep a backup ready.
